editorNotes.whyItWorks: Rich organic textures—cable-knit cashmere, brushed wool overcoats, and crisp fallen foliage—harmonize effortlessly with overcast autumnal daylight. The 85mm f/1.8 lens setting produces a soft, creamy background bokeh that highlights fabric weave and stitching.
editorNotes.variationGuide: Transform the mood to high-fashion winter editorial by exchanging camel tones for charcoal and houndstooth, adding light snowfall and frosty breath vapor. Alternatively, shift to spring trench coats with blossoming magnolia branches.
editorNotes.failureModes: Knitwear can sometimes render as smooth muddy plastic if prompts lack micro-texture descriptors. Including 'tactile cashmere wool knit, visible fabric grain, and sharp eye catchlights' helps achieve high tactile fidelity.
editorNotes.exampleTweak: Replace camel coat with 'emerald-green heavy wool trench coat paired with a cream turtleneck sweater, holding an umbrella in gentle drizzle'.
